name: Furry Takeover
blurb: A furry convention with cabin, lodge and campsite lodging at Fontana Village Resort & Marina in Fontana Dam, North Carolina.
notes: The official site gives no explicit dates for the 2026 edition itself (only 'FTO 2026', 'REGISTRATION CLOSED', and a panel-submission deadline of June 29, 2026); a web search confirms Furry Takeover 2026 ran September 25-27, 2026 at Fontana Village Resort & Marina, Fontana Dam, NC, which already ended before the 2026-10-05 research window, so it is recorded as 'last'. No 2027 dates are announced anywhere on the site (schedule is now handled entirely through the ConTrack app, not a web page). Guests were not researched since there is no upcoming edition to attach them to; the site has no dedicated guest-of-honor program visible on its pages.
